The '''Arda Rebel starfleet''' was the collective name for the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and other [[Starship/Legends|starships]] based at [[Arda Base]]. It included the Base's three starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]]: [[Dust Squadron]], [[Rust Squadron]], and [[Vortex Squadron (Arda I)|Vortex Squadron]].<ref name="OAA1">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref>
